status.en: 11 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 50% fewer than the week before, most of them in Baghdad, Kirkuk and Sulaymaniyah.
status.nb: 11 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 50 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Baghdad, Kirkuk og Sulaymaniyah.

summary.en: Iraqi security forces have arrested an Iraqi duo suspected of plotting attacks on a synagogue in Germany and have foiled a smuggling attempt of 36,000 liters of crude oil in Kirkuk, while also discovering a breach in a pipeline there. Baghdad has closed two border crossings in the Kurdistan region with Syria and Iran and ordered a nationwide deployment to secure oil fields, prompting protests by families of terrorism victims over benefit cuts in Mosul and demands for jobs by petroleum engineering graduates in Kirkuk. President Al Zaidi has called for dialogue and constitutional commitment as Trump backs his efforts to assert state authority, and a former US diplomat has criticized the Erbil-Baghdad dispute. The UCDP recorded 396 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

background.extract: The Iraqi conflict is a series of violent events that began with the 2003 American-led invasion of Iraq and deposition of Iraqi dictator Saddam Hussein, followed by a series of conflicts including the protracted Iraq War (2003–2011), the Iraqi insurgency (2011–2013), the War in Iraq (2013–2017), and most recently, the small-scale Islamic State insurgency in 4 provinces located in Northern Iraq since 2017.
